title: Invocation-local measured milliseconds; no server generation or host handoff estimate

total.description: Elapsed monotonic time until this receipt snapshot. Excludes stdout handoff and any subsequent external activity.

preparation.description: Measured local work outside the separately instrumented phases, including request and credential preparation.

catalog.description: Catalogue request and bounded response handling, observed locally.

request.description: Other API request and complete bounded response handling, including synchronous processing/transfer wait. Not server-only generation time.

wait.description: Foreground same-task waiting inside this command.

content_response.description: Content request until response headers or request failure, including connection and server/network wait. Not proof of server-only preparation or media-byte progress.

download.description: Content response body handling and streaming disk writes after headers, including byte-read waits; excludes separately measured response wait and local verification. It does not prove continuous byte progress.

verification.description: Local media validation, integrity checks and output verification. No host attachment observation.
